documentation.name: 01-llm-layer.md
documentation.summary: Reference doc for the LLM multi-protocol abstraction layer: design goals, the rationale for building in-house vs LiteLLM, the unified data model, four key protocol differences (system-message placement, tool-call message format, usage fields, streaming event structure), GLM integration details with 2026 model-selection guidance, and how to add a new provider.

documentation.name: 02-agent-graph.md
documentation.summary: Reference doc for LangGraph-based agent orchestration: why LangGraph, the hand-written ReAct loop design with three core components and agent state, why a custom ReAct was chosen over create_react_agent, short-term memory integration, the tool system, and infinite-loop prevention.

documentation.name: 03-memory.md
documentation.summary: Reference doc for the three-tier memory system (short-term checkpointer, long-term store, and conversation log), how memories are injected into the dialogue, and how long-term memory differs from the user profile.

documentation.name: 04-mcp.md
documentation.summary: Reference doc for Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration: both directions (client connecting external tools and server exposing the agent's own tools), external server configuration, the tool registry as the single source of truth, and the version strategy.

documentation.name: 05-skills.md
documentation.summary: Reference doc for the Skill system: why skills exist, their structure, declarative decorator-style usage, the workflow, the built-in math_assistant example, the relationship between Skill, Tool, and MCP, and how to add a new skill.

documentation.name: 06-user-profile.md
documentation.summary: Reference doc for the user-profile subsystem built on a graph database: the rationale for graph DB, the data model (nodes and relationships), the API, graceful degradation, Cypher query examples, and collaboration with long-term memory.

documentation.name: 07-a2a.md
documentation.summary: Reference doc for the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol on a2a-sdk 1.1.x / v1.0: protocol essentials, the endpoints this agent exposes, both directions (server exposing the agent and client calling external agents), multi-agent collaboration scenarios, and the Agent Card.

documentation.name: 08-hermes-evolution.md
documentation.summary: Reference doc for Hermes self-evolution: two core capabilities (automatic memory/profile learning, and reflection plus prompt self-optimization), prompt version management, API endpoints, and config switches.

documentation.name: 09-auth-tenant.md
documentation.summary: Reference doc for user authentication and multi-tenancy: JWT auth mechanism, endpoints, and config switches; multi-tenant isolation with an unforgeable tenant_id; Redis sliding-window rate limiting with exemptions; and why the core layers need no changes for these concerns.

documentation.name: 10-rag-enterprise.md
documentation.summary: Reference doc for the RAG knowledge base and enterprise capabilities: the retrieval-augmented generation pipeline reusing existing infrastructure, file/image upload with security, usage statistics with cost estimation, observability via /metrics, and a full enterprise-capability comparison.

data.name: GET /health
data.summary: Liveness probe returning the app name, version, and default LLM provider.

data.name: GET /tools
data.summary: Lists all Agent tools (built-in + MCP + Skills) with risk levels and the configured approval mode.

data.name: GET /skills
data.summary: Lists registered Skills and their loaded status.

data.name: POST /chat
data.summary: Blocking chat: runs the LangGraph agent to completion (with memory/profile injection) and returns the full reply, thread_id, and provider.

data.name: POST /chat/stream
data.summary: Streaming chat over SSE (EventSource) yielding token-level and tool-call events for browser clients.

data.name: POST /chat/http-stream
data.summary: Streaming chat over NDJSON (StreamingResponse) for CLI and non-browser clients.

data.name: POST /memory
data.summary: Stores a long-term memory entry for the authenticated user (tenant-scoped).

data.name: GET /memory/{user_id}
data.summary: Semantic search of a user's long-term memories; owner-checked when auth is enabled.

data.name: GET /memory/{user_id}/all
data.summary: Lists all long-term memories for a user; owner-checked.

data.name: DELETE /memory/{user_id}/{key}
data.summary: Deletes a specific user memory by key; owner-checked.

data.name: POST /profile/interest
data.summary: Records a user interest into the profile service under the tenant-scoped identity.

data.name: POST /profile/preference
data.summary: Records a user key/value preference under the tenant-scoped identity.

data.name: GET /profile/{user_id}
data.summary: Retrieves the full user profile; owner-checked and tenant-scoped.

data.name: GET /history/{thread_id}
data.summary: Fetches conversation event history for a session from MongoDB; enforces tenant + ownership to prevent IDOR.

data.name: POST /chat/cancel/{thread_id}
data.summary: Cancels an in-progress streaming generation; owner-checked so users cannot interrupt others' sessions.

data.name: GET /sessions
data.summary: Lists chat sessions, tenant-scoped and restricted to the caller's own when authenticated.

data.name: POST /sessions
data.summary: Creates a new chat session and returns its thread_id (tenant-scoped).

data.name: GET /sessions/{thread_id}
data.summary: Fetches a single session; tenant + owner-checked.

data.name: PATCH /sessions/{thread_id}
data.summary: Renames a session; tenant + owner-checked.

data.name: DELETE /sessions/{thread_id}
data.summary: Deletes a session and cleans up associated state; tenant + owner-checked.

data.name: POST /evolution/reflect
data.summary: Admin-only: triggers the Hermes self-reflection loop to evaluate and optionally auto-adopt a new global system prompt.

data.name: GET /evolution/prompt
data.summary: Admin-only: returns the currently active system prompt and its version.

data.name: GET /evolution/versions
data.summary: Admin-only: lists historical system-prompt versions.

data.name: POST /evolution/rollback/{version}
data.summary: Admin-only: rolls back the active system prompt to a specified historical version.

data.name: GET /stats/usage
data.summary: Token usage and cost statistics; non-admins are locked to their own data while admins see tenant-wide totals.

data.name: GET /metrics
data.summary: Admin-only: runtime metrics (request counts, latency, infrastructure status).

data.name: POST /auth/register
data.summary: Registers a new user and returns a JWT immediately (skipping a second login step); tenant resolved server-side.

data.name: POST /auth/login
data.summary: Authenticates username/password credentials and returns a JWT.

data.name: GET /auth/me
data.summary: Returns the currently authenticated user's identity, tenant, and role.

data.name: 001_fix_conversations_schema.sql
data.summary: Idempotent Postgres migration (wrapped in a transaction) that fixes the conversations table schema: widens user_id to VARCHAR(128) and drops its users FK so anonymous/CLI string IDs stop breaking inserts, adds a tenant_id column defaulting to 'default', replaces the globally-unique thread_id constraint with a composite (tenant_id, thread_id) unique index to prevent cross-tenant collisions, and adds tenant-scoped lookup indexes for list queries.

data.name: conversations
data.summary: The conversations table targeted by this migration — stores per-thread conversation state. This migration relaxes its user_id column to accept non-UUID strings and introduces tenant_id partitioning so multiple tenants can share the same thread_id without overwriting each other.

data.name: init.sql
data.summary: PostgreSQL initialization schema installing pgcrypto, pg_trgm, and vector extensions and creating the users and conversations tables with tenant-scoped indexes and a demo user.

data.name: users
data.summary: Core users/accounts table with username, email, tenant_id, and password_hash columns, seeded with a demo user.

data.name: conversations
data.summary: Conversation metadata table keyed by (tenant_id, thread_id) to align with the LangGraph checkpointer thread_id.

config.name: .env.example
config.summary: Canonical environment-variable template (67 settings) covering app runtime, OpenTelemetry tracing, multi-provider LLM keys (GLM/OpenAI/Anthropic), embeddings, agent limits, workspace/tool approval, command sandbox, and Postgres/Mongo/Redis/Neo4j DSNs, plus JWT auth, multi-tenancy, rate limiting, uploads, and Hermes learning flags. Each variable maps 1:1 to a field on app/core/config.py:Settings.

config.name: pyproject.toml
config.summary: PEP 621 build/dependency manifest for the self-agent Python (>=3.12) package. Declares the FastAPI/LangGraph/MCP/A2A stack with upper-bound version pins on every dependency for reproducible builds, optional-dependency extras, hatchling build backend targeting the app/ package, dependency-groups for dev tooling, and ruff + pytest configuration.

config.name: package.json
config.summary: npm manifest for the self-agent-web client, declaring runtime dependencies (react, react-dom, react-markdown) and Vite 5 dev tooling, with dev/build/preview scripts that drive the Vite bundler.

config.name: .understandignore
config.summary: Ignore rules for the Understand-Anything code-analysis tool itself, excluding generated artifacts, caches, and vendored code from the knowledge-graph scan.

config.name: pyproject.toml
config.summary: Hatchling package manifest for selfagent-cli declaring the httpx/rich/prompt_toolkit dependencies, the selfagent console-script entry point (selfagent_cli.main:main), and the dependency on the main self-agent package for local in-process mode.

config.name: vite.config.js
config.summary: Vite build configuration for the React web client, wiring the React plugin and proxying /api requests to the FastAPI backend on port 8000.

config.name: init.js
config.summary: MongoDB initialization script creating the conversation_events and app_logs collections with indexes on thread_id, user_id, and timestamps.

config.name: mcp_servers.json.example
config.summary: Example configuration for external MCP server connections, demonstrating stdio (local subprocess) and http (streamable-http remote) transports consumed by MultiServerMCPClient.

list.name: Core Foundation
list.description: Cross-cutting foundation for the Self-Agent FastAPI service: central configuration, structured logging and the MongoDB logging service, OpenTelemetry tracing, custom exceptions, the multi-database connection manager (Postgres/Mongo/Redis/Neo4j), rate-limit middleware, the command sandbox, and workspace management.

list.name: LLM Abstraction
list.description: Multi-protocol LLM provider abstraction (base interface, factory, shared Pydantic models, and the Anthropic / OpenAI-like / GLM provider implementations) that lets the agent target several model vendors behind a single client API.

list.name: Agent Runtime & Memory
list.description: The LangGraph 1.x ReAct agent runtime — graph wiring, agent and tool-execution nodes, planning and state management, context and cancellation registries, the built-in file/shell tools, and the memory subsystem (Postgres checkpointer, pgvector store, embeddings, and the local store).

list.name: Agent Integrations & Domain Services
list.description: External protocols and domain capabilities the agent delegates to: the MCP server/client and A2A executor/server/client, plus the skill registry and builtins, enterprise RAG upload/retrieve, the Hermes self-improvement loop (reflector, memory learner, prompt store), the Neo4j user-profile service, and the session/stats/observability services.

list.name: API & HTTP Surface
list.description: FastAPI HTTP surface — the application composition root (main.py), the chat/SSE/memory/session/evolution/admin routers, Pydantic request/response schemas, the upload router, and the 26 REST endpoints (health, tools, skills, chat stream, memory, profile, sessions, evolution, stats, metrics) mounted on the service.

list.name: Authentication & Multi-Tenancy
list.description: Authentication and multi-tenant isolation layer — JWT issuance and verification, tenant-context propagation, the user registration/login service, FastAPI auth dependencies, and the /auth register, login, and me endpoints.

list.name: Client Applications
list.description: Deliverable client applications consuming the agent service — the React + Vite web chat SPA (App/Login views, SSE streaming API client, styles, entry HTML, package and Vite config) and the selfagent_cli Python CLI (API/config helpers, local in-process mode, REPL, and terminal rendering).

list.name: Infrastructure & Data Stack
list.description: Deployment orchestration, database schemas, and project configuration — the docker-compose stack (Postgres/pgvector, Mongo, Redis, Neo4j, Jaeger), PostgreSQL init schema and the conversations migration, the Mongo init script, plus root configuration (.env template, pyproject, MCP-servers example, and the understand-anything ignore file).

list.name: Documentation
list.description: Project documentation set — the root README, the zero-to-hero overview, the architecture reference, per-module guides (LLM layer, agent graph, memory, MCP, skills, user profile, A2A, Hermes evolution, auth/tenant, enterprise RAG), development setup, guides, interview prep, and the planning notes.

list.name: Test & Verification
list.description: Automated verification harness — the pytest suite (API smoke, client contract, coding tools, local mode, planning, sandbox, telemetry, unit, and regression tests) and the scripts/ end-to-end phase-verification scripts plus the test-data cleanup utility.

file:app/a2a/executor.py.name: executor.py
file:app/a2a/executor.py.summary: Implements the A2A (Agent-to-Agent) protocol executor that wraps the LangGraph agent, exposing execute and cancel operations for remote agent invocation.

file:app/a2a/server.py.name: server.py
file:app/a2a/server.py.summary: Mounts A2A JSON-RPC and REST routes onto a FastAPI application, wiring up the executor, agent card, and in-memory task store.

file:app/a2a/standalone.py.name: standalone.py
file:app/a2a/standalone.py.summary: Standalone entry point that creates a minimal FastAPI app exposing only the A2A endpoint, runnable via uvicorn with configurable host and port.

file:app/agent/registry.py.name: registry.py
file:app/agent/registry.py.summary: Central tool registry managing tool registration, lookup, and risk classification (safe vs destructive) for the agent's tool-calling system.

file:app/agent/tools/__init__.py.name: __init__.py
file:app/agent/tools/__init__.py.summary: Built-in agent tools including a safe AST-based arithmetic calculator, current-time lookup with timezone support, and a mock weather query.

file:app/agent/tools/files.py.name: files.py
file:app/agent/tools/files.py.summary: File-system tools for the agent: read, list, glob, grep, write, edit, and delete, all routed through workspace path resolution and sensitive-file guards.

file:app/agent/tools/shell.py.name: shell.py
file:app/agent/tools/shell.py.summary: Shell command execution tool that integrates sandbox wrapping (bubblewrap/Landlock), blocks destructive commands, and captures output with timeout handling.

file:app/core/logging.py.name: logging.py
file:app/core/logging.py.summary: Centralized logging configuration with OpenTelemetry trace-ID injection via a custom log filter, configurable format and log level from application settings.

file:app/db/manager.py.name: manager.py
file:app/db/manager.py.summary: Unified database connection manager for PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, and Neo4j with lazy connect/disconnect lifecycle and settings-driven backend selection.

file:app/logging_service/__init__.py.name: __init__.py
file:app/logging_service/__init__.py.summary: Conversation logging service that persists chat events to MongoDB, with graceful fallback when the database backend is unavailable.

file:app/mcp/server.py.name: server.py
file:app/mcp/server.py.summary: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that exposes the agent's built-in tools over stdio or HTTP/SSE transports using the FastMCP framework.

file:app/memory/local_store.py.name: local_store.py
file:app/memory/local_store.py.summary: SQLite-based LangGraph checkpointer factory for local development, deriving per-workspace database paths via content hashing.

file:app/middleware/rate_limit.py.name: rate_limit.py
file:app/middleware/rate_limit.py.summary: ASGI rate-limiting middleware using Redis sliding-window counters with configurable limits and per-identity tracking.

file:app/profile/service.py.name: service.py
file:app/profile/service.py.summary: User profile service managing interests and preferences, backed by Neo4j graph storage with an in-memory fallback when Neo4j is unavailable.

file:app/sandbox.py.name: sandbox.py
file:app/sandbox.py.summary: Command sandboxing layer using Linux Landlock LSM and bubblewrap for filesystem confinement, network restriction, and private temporary directories.

file:app/services/session_service.py.name: session_service.py
file:app/services/session_service.py.summary: Chat session CRUD service backed by PostgreSQL, managing session lifecycle, renaming, deletion, and thread-state cleanup.

file:app/services/stats_service.py.name: stats_service.py
file:app/services/stats_service.py.summary: Usage statistics service aggregating conversation events from MongoDB, with per-model token usage and cost estimation.

file:app/workspace.py.name: workspace.py
file:app/workspace.py.summary: Workspace abstraction enforcing path confinement to a root directory, with .gitignore-aware ignore matching and sensitive-file protection.

file:app/agent/context_manager.py.name: context_manager.py
file:app/agent/context_manager.py.summary: Compresses long conversation histories by summarizing older messages via the LLM so the agent stays within token/context limits while keeping the most recent turns intact.

file:app/core/exceptions.py.name: exceptions.py
file:app/core/exceptions.py.summary: Defines the project-wide AppError exception hierarchy and registers FastAPI global exception handlers that convert application and unexpected errors into a uniform JSON error envelope (hiding details in production).

file:app/evolution/memory_learner.py.name: memory_learner.py
file:app/evolution/memory_learner.py.summary: Part of the Hermes self-improvement loop: after each conversation it asks the LLM to extract the user's interests, preferences, and facts, then persists them via the profile and memory services.

file:app/evolution/prompt_store.py.name: prompt_store.py
file:app/evolution/prompt_store.py.summary: File-backed versioned store for the agent's system prompt: tracks a current version and a full history of prompt versions with metadata (source, score, note), supporting save, list, and rollback.

file:app/evolution/reflector.py.name: reflector.py
file:app/evolution/reflector.py.summary: The Hermes reflection step: pulls recent successful conversation samples, asks the LLM to critique and refine the current system prompt, scores the result, and auto-applies the new version when the score clears a configurable threshold.

file:app/llm/__init__.py.name: __init__.py
file:app/llm/__init__.py.summary: Package barrel for the multi-protocol LLM abstraction layer: re-exports the LLMClient protocol, the get_llm_client factory, and the provider-agnostic data models so callers depend only on app.llm.

file:app/llm/base.py.name: base.py
file:app/llm/base.py.summary: Defines LLMClient, the runtime-checkable Protocol every provider implements, exposing provider_name/default_model properties plus chat() and stream_chat() methods that all of GLM/OpenAI/Anthropic conform to.

file:app/llm/factory.py.name: factory.py
file:app/llm/factory.py.summary: Factory that builds the configured LLMClient implementation (GLM and OpenAI share OpenAILikeClient via OpenAI-compatible endpoints; Anthropic uses AnthropicClient), with an lru-cached singleton accessor for runtime provider switching.

file:app/llm/models.py.name: models.py
file:app/llm/models.py.summary: Provider-agnostic Pydantic data models for the LLM layer: messages, tool calls, tool definitions, token usage, and the unified request/response/stream-chunk types that every provider converts to and from.

file:app/llm/providers/anthropic.py.name: anthropic.py
file:app/llm/providers/anthropic.py.summary: Anthropic LLMClient implementation: adapts the unified ChatRequest/Response models to the Anthropic Messages API, including system-message splitting, tool translation, response parsing, and streaming via the Anthropic SDK.

file:app/llm/providers/openai_like.py.name: openai_like.py
file:app/llm/providers/openai_like.py.summary: OpenAI-compatible LLMClient implementation shared by OpenAI and GLM (zhipu): translates the unified models to/from the OpenAI chat.completions API, with cross-chunk tool-call aggregation for streaming.

file:scripts/verify_agent.py.name: verify_agent.py
file:scripts/verify_agent.py.summary: End-to-end smoke test for the agent run loop: injects a MockLLMClient into the factory cache and exercises run_agent to confirm the graph executes and the mock satisfies the LLMClient protocol.

file:scripts/verify_hermes.py.name: verify_hermes.py
file:scripts/verify_hermes.py.summary: End-to-end smoke test for the Hermes self-improvement loop: drives memory_learner.learn_from_conversation and exercises the prompt_store save/list/rollback lifecycle with a mock LLM.

file:scripts/verify_phase2.py.name: verify_phase2.py
file:scripts/verify_phase2.py.summary: Smoke test for phase-2 subsystems: checks the skill and tool registries, MCP server build/config loading, system-prompt assembly, and a mock-driven agent run.

file:scripts/verify_stream.py.name: verify_stream.py
file:scripts/verify_stream.py.summary: Smoke test for the streaming agent path: runs stream_agent with a mock streaming LLM and collects the emitted event stream to validate streaming chunks and tool events.

file:app/a2a/client.py.name: client.py
file:app/a2a/client.py.summary: A2A (Agent-to-Agent) protocol client that validates remote agent URLs against a configured allowlist with SSRF guard, then delegates messages via the A2A SDK and extracts text from responses.

file:app/api/upload_routes.py.name: upload_routes.py
file:app/api/upload_routes.py.summary: FastAPI router for knowledge-base file uploads with extension/size validation, path-traversal-safe basename handling, async disk writes, and optional auto-ingest into the RAG service.

file:app/core/config.py.name: config.py
file:app/core/config.py.summary: Central pydantic-settings configuration defining all environment-driven settings (LLM providers, Postgres/Mongo/Redis/Neo4j, MCP, A2A, JWT auth, rate-limit, sandbox, storage) with derived DSN properties and a cached get_settings accessor.

file:app/main.py.name: main.py
file:app/main.py.summary: FastAPI application factory and wiring root: the lifespan context starts the DB pool, MCP client, tool registries, memory store, compiled agent graph and A2A mount, then mounts routers, exception handlers, rate-limit and metrics middleware, and OpenTelemetry.

file:app/mcp/client.py.name: client.py
file:app/mcp/client.py.summary: MCP (Model Context Protocol) client manager that loads server definitions from the configured JSON, connects through MultiServerMCPClient, and exposes the aggregated tool set.

file:app/memory/checkpointer.py.name: checkpointer.py
file:app/memory/checkpointer.py.summary: LangGraph checkpointer factory selecting between SQLite, Postgres (AsyncPostgresSaver), and in-memory MemorySaver based on settings, with reset and persistence-status helpers used by observability and shutdown.

file:app/memory/embeddings.py.name: embeddings.py
file:app/memory/embeddings.py.summary: Embedding layer providing async embedding (aembed) via OpenAI-compatible clients or a deterministic hash fallback, plus provider resolution, dimension config, and startup status logging.

file:app/memory/pg.py.name: pg.py
file:app/memory/pg.py.summary: Async Postgres connection pool (psycopg AsyncConnectionPool) singleton with lazy initialization, timeout-bounded open, and graceful shutdown used by the checkpointer and store.

file:app/memory/store.py.name: store.py
file:app/memory/store.py.summary: Long-term memory store built on LangChain AsyncPostgresStore / InMemoryStore, with per-user/tenant namespacing, vector index config, and a MemoryService facade exposing add/search/list/delete operations.

file:app/rag/routes.py.name: routes.py
file:app/rag/routes.py.summary: FastAPI router exposing RAG endpoints (ingest, search, delete_kb) scoped per knowledge-base id and authenticated user, delegating to the RAG service.

file:app/rag/service.py.name: service.py
file:app/rag/service.py.summary: Enterprise RAG service handling text chunking with overlap, per-knowledge-base namespaced storage in the memory store, vector search, and context-block assembly with XML attribute escaping for prompt injection.

file:app/services/observability.py.name: observability.py
file:app/services/observability.py.summary: Lightweight in-process observability: records per-path response times and request counts, exposes a metrics summary (including checkpointer persistence status), and ships an ASGI MetricsMiddleware.

file:app/__init__.py.name: __init__.py
file:app/__init__.py.summary: Root package marker for the Self-Agent application; exposes the __version__ string consumed by health checks and logging.

file:app/api/routes.py.name: routes.py

table:infra/postgres/migrations/001_fix_.name: 001_fix_conversations_schema.sql
table:infra/postgres/migrations/001_fix_.summary: Idempotent Postgres migration (wrapped in a transaction) that fixes the conversations table schema: widens user_id to VARCHAR(128) and drops its users FK so anonymous/CLI string IDs stop breaking inserts, adds a tenant_id column defaulting to 'default', replaces the globally-unique thread_id constraint with a composite (tenant_id, thread_id) unique index to prevent cross-tenant collisions, and adds tenant-scoped lookup indexes for list queries.

table:infra/postgres/migrations/001_fix_.name: conversations
table:infra/postgres/migrations/001_fix_.summary: The conversations table targeted by this migration — stores per-thread conversation state. This migration relaxes its user_id column to accept non-UUID strings and introduces tenant_id partitioning so multiple tenants can share the same thread_id without overwriting each other.

document:docs/05-interview/README.md.name: README.md
document:docs/05-interview/README.md.summary: Interview-preparation notes distilling the project design decisions and trade-offs into Q&A form for technical discussion.

document:infra/README.md.name: README.md
document:infra/README.md.summary: Infrastructure README explaining the five-service Docker stack (Postgres, Mongo, Redis, Neo4j, Jaeger), their roles, and operational commands.

service:infra/docker-compose.yml.name: docker-compose.yml
service:infra/docker-compose.yml.summary: Core infrastructure orchestrator bringing up the five-service stack: pgvector Postgres, MongoDB, Redis, Jaeger, and Neo4j, with health checks and persistent volumes.

config:infra/mongo/init.js.name: init.js
config:infra/mongo/init.js.summary: MongoDB initialization script creating the conversation_events and app_logs collections with indexes on thread_id, user_id, and timestamps.

schema:infra/postgres/init.sql.name: init.sql
schema:infra/postgres/init.sql.summary: PostgreSQL initialization schema installing pgcrypto, pg_trgm, and vector extensions and creating the users and conversations tables with tenant-scoped indexes and a demo user.

config:mcp_servers.json.example.name: mcp_servers.json.example
config:mcp_servers.json.example.summary: Example configuration for external MCP server connections, demonstrating stdio (local subprocess) and http (streamable-http remote) transports consumed by MultiServerMCPClient.

file:scripts/cleanup_test_data.py.name: cleanup_test_data.py
file:scripts/cleanup_test_data.py.summary: Utility script that purges test-generated threads, conversations, and memory records from the database, identifying them by test thread-id prefixes.

file:scripts/verify_e2e.py.name: verify_e2e.py
file:scripts/verify_e2e.py.summary: End-to-end verification script that exercises the chat API NDJSON and SSE streaming endpoints against a mock LLM to validate the full request/response contract.

file:scripts/verify_phase3.py.name: verify_phase3.py
file:scripts/verify_phase3.py.summary: Phase-3 verification script validating the long-term memory store, user profile service, conversation logger, and the agent graph memory-injected system prompt.

file:scripts/verify_phase4.py.name: verify_phase4.py
file:scripts/verify_phase4.py.summary: Phase-4 verification script validating the A2A (agent-to-agent) executor, server mounting, client delegation, and tool registration against a mock LLM.

file:scripts/verify_phase8.py.name: verify_phase8.py
file:scripts/verify_phase8.py.summary: Phase-8 verification script exercising JWT auth, tenant namespacing, RAG chunking, cost estimation, observability metrics, and the mounted FastAPI app.

file:scripts/verify_sessions.py.name: verify_sessions.py
file:scripts/verify_sessions.py.summary: Verification script for session-management features: context compression, the cancel registry, and cancellation of in-flight streams through the API.

file:tests/conftest.py.name: conftest.py
file:tests/conftest.py.summary: Shared pytest fixtures that block external I/O (network and disk) and reset in-memory singletons (checkpointer, store, db_manager) for test isolation.

file:tests/test_api_smoke.py.name: test_api_smoke.py
file:tests/test_api_smoke.py.summary: Smoke tests for the FastAPI API: health, root, chat (with tool calls, multi-turn, streaming), tool listing, and skill listing, all against a mock LLM.

file:tests/test_client_contract.py.name: test_client_contract.py
file:tests/test_client_contract.py.summary: Contract tests pinning the SSE/NDJSON wire format between the web and CLI clients and the server, covering CRLF separators, ping skipping, and CLI auth handling.

file:tests/test_coding_tools.py.name: test_coding_tools.py
file:tests/test_coding_tools.py.summary: Tests for the coding agent tools: workspace path confinement, file tools (read/write/edit/delete/grep with secret refusal), shell execution, and the approval policy gating.

table:infra/postgres/init.sql:users.name: users
table:infra/postgres/init.sql:users.summary: Core users/accounts table with username, email, tenant_id, and password_hash columns, seeded with a demo user.

table:infra/postgres/init.sql:conversati.name: conversations
table:infra/postgres/init.sql:conversati.summary: Conversation metadata table keyed by (tenant_id, thread_id) to align with the LangGraph checkpointer thread_id.

file:tests/test_local_mode.py.name: test_local_mode.py
file:tests/test_local_mode.py.summary: Tests CLI local mode: SQLite single-file storage, the full approval-interrupt round-trip, and the contract that the agent event stream must be fully consumed before resume (early break silently loses the interrupt).

file:tests/test_plan.py.name: test_plan.py
file:tests/test_plan.py.summary: Tests the task-planning external scratchpad: strict validation of model-supplied plan steps, and that the plan actually lands in graph state and survives the checkpointer rather than only appearing in a message.

file:tests/test_sandbox.py.name: test_sandbox.py
file:tests/test_sandbox.py.summary: Tests the command sandbox by asserting actual interception behavior (not config correctness): workspace stays usable while outside-workspace reads/writes are blocked, plus bwrap argv construction and private-tmp isolation.

file:tests/test_telemetry.py.name: test_telemetry.py
file:tests/test_telemetry.py.summary: Tests OpenTelemetry tracing by capturing real spans with an in-memory exporter and asserting the span tree shape (parent/child nesting and shared trace id) rather than mere instrumentation presence.

file:tests/test_regressions.py.name: test_regressions.py
file:tests/test_regressions.py.summary: Regression suite for silent-failure and authorization bugs: test isolation (blackhole DBs), LangGraph persistence API usage, RAG delete/namespace/context wrapping, tenant authorization, prompt accumulation, single-LLM-call-per-turn, and tool-node truncation/concurrency.

file:tests/test_unit.py.name: test_unit.py
file:tests/test_unit.py.summary: Fast pure-logic unit tests with no DB/LLM/network dependencies: calculator safe evaluation, time tool, tool registry, LLM message-format conversions, in-memory store, profile fallback, config parsing, skills, security, auth, multi-tenant namespacing, RAG chunking, cost estimation, and rate-limit identity.
